title: Single Arc<Mutex<Connection>> serializes all DB access
evidence: src/lib.rs:14,77 — one Connection behind a Mutex shared by every handler; each request takes the lock
suggestion: Acceptable for this task's scale; a connection pool (r2d2/deadpool) would allow concurrent reads if throughput mattered
